en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5692 - Musa ibn Bakr narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said: "
The inheritance of the child of mula'anah belongs to his mother. If his mother is not alive, then it goes to the closest relatives on his mother's side - his maternal uncles."
